verify_commands.dd_text: When run against a story whose targeted symbol repeats at or above the threshold, the plan header records a migration-class:sweep marker

When run against a story touching schema/migration file patterns (migrations/, alembic/, db/migrate, *.migration.ts, schema.sql), the plan header records a migration-class:db marker regardless of call-site count
Call-site counting tallies only the specifically targeted symbol or API and excludes surrounding boilerplate, imports, and test files

The sweep repetition threshold is read from config key migration.call_site_threshold with a documented default, and a test overriding the config moves a borderline target across the classification boundary
The persisted marker includes the detection query string, and a test asserts the query is retrievable from the marker after persistence
Classification persists the marker without emitting a user-confirmation prompt, asserted by a non-interactive test
When sg is unavailable the plan header records an explicit migration-class:inconclusive marker (never silently false) and the planner does not crash
Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic
